notes.title: Dark Home is coming, Free-To-Play
notes.notes: Hello! This announcement is to let those of you who might see this know; Dark Home will be free to play soon.  Thank you.

notes.title: Let's have a Game Night!
notes.notes:
Howdy, friends!  We're looking to host a game night [b]July 25th[/b] from [u]8pm to 9:30pm EST (7pm to 8:30pm CST)[/u] .  Gather some friends into our discord and we'll try to keep everyone notified before we start!    The lobbies max out at 9 players (1 spirit, 8 children) so try to be early unless you plan to start your own server!  
  
 Cheers and have fun until then! 


Don't forget our official discord! Little bare bones at the moment so bare with us! 
[url=https://discord.gg/n4TDWNB6Xq]Our Discord[/url]

Also, remember to be kind to others! [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40815561/30c421d88405441fae9374c413bcf3b5682ea8a1.png[/img]

[b]Spirit's Weapon hitbox increased.[/b]

[b]Coldwood Map[/b] lighting fixed.

[b]Coldwood Map[/b] collision allowing players to exit map; fixed.
